name: TAF Inpatient Claims Header File
description: The TAF Inpatient Claims Header file contains claim-level records for inpatient hospital services billed to Medicaid. Each record represents one inpatient claim and includes admission/discharge information, diagnosis codes, DRG assignments, and claim payment totals. Note: not all states are available in TAF data from 2014-2015, as this was a transition period between MAX and TAF. From 2016-2018, all states are available.
